accepted.quote: Description: A large residential complex, built in ca. 128 CE as part of the Hadrianic remodeling of Ostia. Its central area was occupied by two blocks, each comprising four houses, surrounded by a garden furnished with six fountains. Representative point: longitude 12.284756, latitude 41.751816.
accepted.note: Built ca. 128 CE as part of Hadrian's remodelling of Ostia.
